claim: A standing jump (normalJumpZ -0xbaaaa against kDudeGravity 58,254, stepped tick by tick as MoveDude does) rises about 15,370 z, 0.91 of a standing body, so with the 4,096 walking step on top a player gets out of a pit or onto a ledge of roughly 19,500 z and no more. For the other direction: landing damage is mulscale30(zvel, zvel) - kFallDamageFloor (1,600), and gravity is not added on the tick whose move already reaches the floor; stepped so, the last painless drop from rest is 67,570 z (3.98 bodies), the next unit hurts, and raw damage reaches 1,600 (100 hit points before the player's damage factor) at 126,957 (7.49 bodies).
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/actor.h:185-187 (kDudeGravity, kDudeAirborneHeight, kFallDamageFloor); player.cpp:134 normalJumpZ; actor.cpp:4596-4631 (MoveDude's integration; gravity skipped at :4625 when bottom >= floorZ) and :4815-4847 (landing damage; actFloorBounceVector :2691-2698 returns zvel on a flat floor)
knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_jump_fall.py steps that order: apex 15,367; last painless 67,570; 1,600 raw at 126,957 (2026-11-26)
in a bot run AGTST3 climbed an 11,264 rise by jumping and refused a 21,504 one (2026-08-27, not repeated)
use: A drop entry under about 3.9 bodies never hurts; a mouth or ledge under jump plus step (about 19,500 z) can be climbed back out, which is the test for 'this pit is not a trap'. bloodmap.layers.fall_cost prices a drop in the same order.

checked.how: player.cpp:134 normalJumpZ -0xbaaaa; actor.h:185-187 g 58254, floor 100<<4; actor.cpp:4595-4632 (MoveDude) gravity skipped when bottom >= floorZ (:4625), landing :4826-4847. Ran probes/audit2_jump_fall.py: apex 15,367; last painless 67,570; 1,600 raw at 126,957. bloodmap.layers.fall_cost agrees since its correction on 2026-11-26 (67,570 -> 0, 67,571 -> 4.44).
